$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\sqrt{x}+tan⁡x) \\  & =1\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\sqrt{x})+1\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(tan⁡x) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}})+1({sec}^{2}⁡x) \\  & =\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{\sqrt{x}}+{sec}^{2}⁡x.\end{aligned}
